access.value: War grave under State protection; unauthorised diving is illegal

hazards.text: Ropes and nets around the wreck

s1.quote: The seabed is 38 to 40 metres (125 to 131 ft) below sea level … The wreck is suitable for advanced, experienced divers only

s2.quote: The wreck is found 820 metres from the southwest coast, between Es Talaier and Cala Turqueta, at a depth of 38 metres.

highlights.text: Cement cargo forms an artificial reef full of fish

s1.quote: Lying only 25m from the shore … Catering for every level of diver, for novices up to experts
